open_points.subject: A10 rule 7 request_digest coverage
open_points.text: "every header the kernel sends, names lower-cased and in code-point order, each with its value"
open_points.question: Which headers are included in request_digest when the HTTP stack adds transport headers (for example Host, Content-Length, User-Agent, Connection), and are those implicit headers allowed to change approval validity?
options: Include only headers explicitly defined by kernel rules (required headers, credential header name, Accept-Encoding, Content-Type when applicable)
Include all on-the-wire headers after client-library injection
Include a fixed allowlist defined by the kernel, rejecting any extra header emission
open_points.default_guess: Include only a fixed kernel-defined header set and exclude library-added transport headers from request_digest.

open_points.subject: A11 crash recovery and approval status
open_points.text: A11 rule 1: "a crash between those two calls is the in_flight case of rule 4, whose recovery also marks that approval used."; A11 rule 4 defines in_flight -> unknown but does not restate the approval transition.
open_points.question: On restart recovery of an in_flight attempt, must the linked approval always be transitioned to used, and in which store call/order relative to writing outcome_unknown NodeExecution?
options: Always mark linked approval used during in_flight->unknown recovery
Leave approval approved/unused and rely on request_digest checks
Mark used only if authority was approval (not grant/flow activation), with explicit atomic update
open_points.default_guess: Mark approval used atomically with in_flight->unknown recovery when authority was an approval.

open_points.subject: Guard value equality semantics (A05/A13)
open_points.text: A05/A13 use "guard value equals it" / "delivers only when ... value equals its guard value" without defining equality semantics.
open_points.question: What exact equality algorithm is used for comparing JSON guard values (notably numeric forms like 1 vs 1.0, object key order, and string normalization)?
options: JSON semantic equality by parsed value types
Host-language equality of decoded runtime objects
open_points.default_guess: Use canonical-JSON semantic equality via RFC 8785-normalized value representation.

open_points.subject: Resume authority for draft-write elements
open_points.text: A14 rule 2 says resume authority is "its unused approval ... or a grant still active"; A10 rule 1 says "draft-write nodes ask nothing at run time" and A10 rule 6 says draft-write authority is flow activation (except resend after not_applied).
open_points.question: When resuming a draft-write element waiting on service_unreachable (not not_applied), is authority flow activation, or must approval/grant be present per A14 wording?
options: Resume draft-write under flow activation authority (normal path)
Require approval/grant on resume despite draft-write default
Branch by prior attempt status (not_sent vs unknown) with explicit rule
open_points.default_guess: Resume draft-write under flow activation authority unless it is a resend after not_applied.

open_points.subject: Manifest-mismatch refusal precedence detail (A08 rule 5 composite checks)
open_points.text: "A proposal is refused as a manifest mismatch, naming the first failing check in the order listed here ... or the ports do not fit the request shape of A09 rules 2 and 3, in that order, ports taken in name order; or its ports break a rule A02 sets for contract ports ..."
open_points.question: Inside the embedded A09/A02 port-shape validations, what exact first-failure precedence must be reported when multiple per-port faults coexist (for example placeholder-type fault and media-type fault)?
options: Define a single flattened global order across all embedded checks and all ports
Report first failure within A09 block before entering A02 block
Allow validator-dependent first error as long as category is manifest_mismatch
open_points.default_guess: Use a flattened deterministic order: A09 rule-2 checks by port/name first, then A09 rule-3 checks, then A02-style port checks.
